name: lem-compcb-amplification-naturality-CONTRACT
source: proofs/lem-compcb-amplification-naturality (af-validated 2026-07-24, 12/12 taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Amplification naturality of the power-series functional calculus: for iota_n: B -> M_n(B) the unital isometric amplification and f a power series on ||X-x_0I||<r, f(iota_n(X)) is defined and f(iota_n(X)) = iota_n(f(X)); in particular theta(iota_n(2P-I)) = iota_n(theta(2P-I)) whenever ||(2P-I)^2-I||<1.
